name: conventional-commits
title_zh: 先给你看 commit 全文，点头才落盘
tagline_zh: 写完 type(scope) 前缀、折行正文和 footer 后，它把消息摊在你面前等你点头；你改一个字它就重排。
tagline_en: Drafts the type(scope) prefix, wrapped body and footers, shows you the whole message, then actually runs git add.
desc_en: Drafts Conventional Commits-style commit messages (type(scope) prefix, description, wrapped body, footers) and actually stages and commits the changes locally with git on the developer's behalf, once they approve the message. Use this whenever someone asks to commit changes, write or draft a commit message, "stage and commit this", "write a conventional commit for this diff", mentions commit types
why_zh: 它把「写消息」和「执行提交」合成一步，而不是丢一段文本让你自己粘。
why_en: It merges drafting and executing: scope and breaking-change footers are inferred from the diff, and the commit runs only after.
limit_zh: 只认 Conventional Commits 那一套 type。
limit_en: Only Conventional Commits types; other conventions (Gitmoji, free-form) still get feat/fix. No merge, rebase, history edits or push — one local.
title_en: Shows you the full commit message before anything is written
